headlines.title: Man arrested in connection with his mom's death in Pleasant Hill
headlines.description: Marin County reported its first flu death of the season. Officials did not say how old the person was, or whether they had any other health conditions. In general, older people, young children, pregnant women and immunocompromised people are at higher risk of severe symptoms or death. The flu is hitting the Bay Area two months earlier than it typically does. Cases started picking up in September, but health leaders said this year’s flu season does not appear to be more severe than other years.
